rule: every real failure produces a reusable invariant, hostile, schema rule, static check, causal guard, or claim ceiling that prevents the entire DEFECT CLASS from silently recurring (HC-9). A hand-written local fix alone is solution accumulation, not hardening.

defect_classes.defect: census counts hand-copied (D28 F4: hostile census 27 vs 29)
defect_classes.class_invariant: registry census is DERIVED from the atoms array, never hand-written
defect_classes.enforcement: derive_census.py recomputes census and fails closed on any mismatch; CI gate ttac-registry-gates runs it

defect_classes.defect: build generators drift from their committed target artifacts (stale-sync class; D28 F6/F7)
defect_classes.class_invariant: a generator's committed output must equal what the generator emits from the committed inputs
defect_classes.enforcement: CI gate ttac-registry-gates re-runs the deterministic rebuild chain (build_d2 -> build_d3 -> build_d9) and fails on git diff

defect_classes.defect: manually amended result its checker cannot reproduce (RV_B1 correction_C1, fixed by #322; D28 F2)
defect_classes.class_invariant: an artifact amended after emission is reproduced by its checker (amendment emitted in-code) OR carries a two-layer raw-result + amendment composition checker
defect_classes.enforcement: byte-repro rule already enforced by the D10 replay discipline; amendment blocks are emitted by the checker (pattern of #322)
defect_classes.status: CLOSED (pattern established by #322); audit remaining amended artifacts = task #52

defect_classes.defect: results outside the freeze hash-chain (D28 F1: 8 exact/results/*.json)
defect_classes.class_invariant: a result supporting a claim is inside a verifiable provenance/freeze chain or explicitly classed post-freeze-derived
defect_classes.enforcement: task #52 owns the freeze-chain extension; new freezes (DEV-CAL-1, D29-31) declare their result-set members IN the freeze file

defect_classes.defect: unreachable freeze_commit reference (D28 F3: 11d165b7 unreachable from any ref)
defect_classes.class_invariant: every freeze binds a commit reachable from main
defect_classes.enforcement: task #52; freeze files must cite merge-commit oids, never PR-head oids that die on squash

defect_classes.defect: receipt schemas accept missing frozen load-bearing field families silently (D28 F5: 7/13 families frozen)
defect_classes.class_invariant: receipt schemas enforce all frozen load-bearing field families or emit CANNOT_CHECK with a reason
defect_classes.enforcement: SEARCH_GEOMETRY_RECEIPT_SCHEMA_V1.invariants + DEV_CAL_1 checker_requirements encode cannot_check-not-silence; retro-fit to older receipt schemas = task #52

defect_classes.defect: duplicate-key JSON identity-weld (B7: QG34 results 7731425f not parse-stable)
defect_classes.class_invariant: committed JSON artifacts are parse-stable: duplicate keys banned
defect_classes.enforcement: python json.loads with object_pairs_hook detecting duplicates added to ttac-registry-gates for research/**/results/*.json and registry artifacts
defect_classes.status: CLOSED_IN_THIS_PR (gate live; the four B7-recorded artifacts stay ledgered as defects in REPLAY_RECEIPTS_V1)

defect_classes.defect: frozen result file mutates across commits (B7: MSC engineering_chain 0->2 post-freeze appends)
defect_classes.class_invariant: a frozen result is immutable; later evidence lands as SEPARATE receipt files, never appended into the frozen artifact
defect_classes.enforcement: rule recorded; mechanical freeze-file digest watcher = task #52

defect_classes.defect: proxy selection manufactures negatives (GS-R2/RV-6: ranking collapsed the endpoint to 1 bit; 84.4% headline permanently unquotable; unranked lane 2.13% compute, 2.21x held-out)
defect_classes.class_invariant: every optimisation/search metric carries a held-out latent-property audit; every 1-bit endpoint carries a draw-invariance control
defect_classes.enforcement: encoded in DEV_CAL_1_PROTOCOL_FREEZE_V1.checker_requirements + ECONOMY_FRONTIER_PROTOCOLS_V1.common_rules; applies programme-wide going forward

defect_classes.defect: adaptive-beats-fixed claim reproduced by a row-shuffle null (FQ-2 retraction)
defect_classes.class_invariant: every adaptive-vs-fixed claim carries a shuffle-equal-n null
defect_classes.enforcement: encoded in DEV-CAL-1 + frontier protocols common rules

defect_classes.defect: vacuous noninterference (EB-F0 v1: writes declared, reads not; protected assay names absent from state graph)
defect_classes.class_invariant: noninterference graphs include reads + writes + multi-hop ancestry; unresolved nodes emit CANNOT_CHECK
defect_classes.enforcement: EB-F0 formal contract frozen at #316; DEV-CAL-1 history-purity checker inherits the rule

defect_classes.defect: missing claim class invisible to closure machinery (TTAC: DEVELOPMENTAL_LINEAGE absent; readiness looked healthy while never scoring the central claim)
defect_classes.class_invariant: every new claim area passes adversarial enumeration; a class with zero atoms is a visible row, not an absence
defect_classes.enforcement: ATOM-DEV-03 registered (DEVELOPMENTAL_LINEAGE, OPEN, no closure) in this PR + census-by-class makes zero-atom classes conspicuous; adversarial enumeration pass before new claim classes = standing TTAC obligation

defect_classes.defect: unimplemented comparator yields a negative reading (SEV-01: matched adaptive parent suite NOT_IMPLEMENTED_ALL_PARENTS)
defect_classes.class_invariant: a lane whose frozen comparator was not implemented emits CANNOT_CLASSIFY, never a negative terminal
defect_classes.enforcement: rule recorded here; applied when SEV lane reopens; DEV-CAL-1 ASSAY_DEFECT terminal encodes the same principle

defect_classes.defect: machine-specific absolute paths in committed builders (B7: qg34_build_primitives.py /private/tmp scratchpad, artifact uncommitted)
defect_classes.class_invariant: committed code contains no machine-specific absolute paths; referenced artifacts are committed
defect_classes.enforcement: grep gate in ttac-registry-gates over research builders for /private/tmp and /Users/ literals
defect_classes.status: CLOSED_IN_THIS_PR (gate live; the qg34 artifact itself stays ledgered as a defect, owner #52)
